title: Nostalgic Smoky Slovakian Pork Kebabs
description: A funky, gooey, nostalgic Slovakian dish featuring barbeque sauce, smoke-hot, low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, this recipe is sure to satisfy your cravings. It combines the richness of pork with the tanginess of barbeque sauce.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together barbeque sauce, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the barbeque sauce mixture.
Thread the pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Add the wood chips to the grill and close the lid to smoke the pork kebabs.
Cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
